_instructions: --- HOW TO ADD AND LINK IMAGES ---
PICTURE ATLAS (chapters) — automatic:
The Picture Atlas is auto-generated from the folder structure under `public/images/atlas/`.
Each subfolder becomes a chapter (tab) in the atlas modal, and every image file inside it is
shown automatically. Supported extensions: jpg, jpeg, png, gif, webp, bmp, tif, tiff, avif.
To add a new chapter: create a new folder and drop image files into it. That is all — labels
are derived from the file names, and the new chapter appears without any code changes.
OPTIONAL manifest registration (recommended):
Add an entry below to provide a curated label and AI search hints, and to make the image
linkable to specific findings in the per-lesion tooltips. It must have:
- `id`: A unique string to identify this image (e.g., 'normal-uc').
- `description`: Text that describes the image (used as the atlas label).
- `imageUrl`: The path to your image. MUST start with '/images/atlas/' and match the folder +
file name exactly, e.g. '/images/atlas/normal/normal uc.png'.
- `imageHint`: One or two keywords for AI image search.
Images already on disk are shown even without a manifest entry; registering only overrides the
auto-generated label and enables tooltip linking.
TOOLTIP LINKAGE (lesion -> images):
Open `src/lib/atlas.ts`. In the `atlasData` map, use the key `"<compartmentId>:<alterationId>"`
for the lesion you want to associate images with (compartment ids: umbilicalCord, membranes,
placentalVilli, maternalDecidua; alteration ids match the `id` fields in `src/lib/constants.ts`).
Add the manifest `id`(s) above to that key's array of image ids.
Example in `src/lib/atlas.ts`:
"placentalVilli:normal": ["normal-term-villi", "my-new-image"]
Tooltip images resolve by manifest id only — an id listed in `atlasData` that is missing from the
manifest below is silently skipped. The Picture Atlas chapters do NOT depend on this manifest.
